title: Friction Event
description: Emitted for friction incidents with root-cause chain context (Issue #18)

subdomain.description: Specific friction subcategory (e.g., file-not-found, resource-limit, command-failed)

tool.description: Name of the tool that experienced friction

file_path.description: File path involved in the friction, if applicable

hint.description: Actionable suggestion for resolving the friction

preceding_tool.description: Tool that executed immediately before this friction event

preceding_result.description: Result of the preceding tool execution

preceding_file.description: File path the preceding tool operated on

chain_depth.description: Number of consecutive failures in this friction chain (0 = isolated failure, >0 = cascading failures)
